use_case_summary: Support assistant: contextual responses from product docs + user history; strong latency requirements for chat UX.
Doc-search/reranking: index embeddings + re-rank candidate answers; throughput bursts during morning SLAs.
Summarization: summarize long crash reports for engineering triage; lower latency tolerance but high accuracy.
Priority: maintain P95 latency < 150ms for support chat; cost-sensitive vs hosted per-token model.
poc_scope: 4-week Dedicated POC: reserve a small GPU pool (2x A100 equiv) to serve 3 routes: chat, embeddings, rerank.
Canary rollouts: begin with 10% traffic on Dedicated, 90% on Hosted -> increase if success criteria met.
Fallback: automated routing to Hosted API and to a smaller quantized model variant during overload or regional failure.
Model variants: primary fp16 variant (open-30B), fallback 8-bit quantized 13B for cost/throughput tradeoffs.
poc_success_criteria: Latency: P95 chat < 120ms on Dedicated under expected traffic mix.
Throughput: sustain 180–220 chat reqs/sec with autoscaling headroom for 20% bursts.
Quality: reranking NDCG lift >= 12% vs current baseline (internal eval set).
Cost: estimated token cost reduction >= 35% vs hosted at projected volumes.
Reliability: seamless failover to Hosted in <30s without data loss; no user-visible errors during canary.
canary_and_fallback_plan: Phase 0 (hosted trial): baseline metrics collection, token distribution, seq-length histogram.
Phase 1 (canary start): route 10% traffic to Dedicated; monitor latency, errors, model divergence metrics every 5m.
Phase 2 (scale): increment to 50% after 72h stable, then 100% if no regressions and cost targets met.
Rollback triggers: sustained p95 increase >20%, error rate >2%, or quality regression on eval prompts.
Region failover: primary region us-east-1 Dedicated -> failover to hosted region eu-west-1 hosted variant in outage scenario.
Model fallback: if Dedicated GPU pool degraded, route to quantized 13B in Dedicated or Hosted-quantized variant.
